summary: The D.C. Elections Board has asked the National Guard to stay away from ballot drop boxes, amid broader concerns about the role of federal military forces in District governance. Advocates including the ACLU have argued against National Guard presence in D.C., while statehood supporters document what they characterize as repeated challenges to local authority and continue pushing for statehood as a solution. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
